blocks.orig: Tarangire Treetops is a luxury safari lodge that offers a unique and unforgettable experience. The lodge features spacious treehouses built on stilts, allowing guests to immerse themselves in the stunning surroundings. Each treehouse has a private balcony overlooking the majestic baobab trees and the park’s abundant wildlife. Guests can enjoy game drives to spot elephants, lions, and other African wildlife, or unwind at the lodge’s pool and spa. With its exceptional service and breathtaking views, Tarangire Treetops promises an extraordinary adventure and luxury.
blocks.html: Tarangire Treetops is a luxury safari lodge where you can enjoy a distinctive and memorable stay. The lodge has roomy treehouses raised on stilts, so guests can fully take in the beautiful surroundings. From the private balcony of each treehouse you look out over the impressive baobab trees and the park’s plentiful wildlife. You can go on game drives in search of elephants, lions and other African animals, or relax at the lodge’s pool and spa. With its excellent service and beautiful views, Tarangire Treetops offers a remarkable combination of adventure and luxury.
